{
  "per_column": [
    {
      "name": "theme_crew_service",
      "analytical_usefulness": 0.8,
      "source_groundedness": 0.95,
      "hallucination_observed": false,
      "rationale": "Binary presence flag for a crew/service theme; directly supports theme-vs-rating analysis. Samples confirm sound reading (crew praise=1, seat-only complaint=0). Partial topical overlap with the existing 'Staff Service' rating but the text-mention signal is a distinct axis."
    },
    {
      "name": "theme_seat_comfort",
      "analytical_usefulness": 0.78,
      "source_groundedness": 0.9,
      "hallucination_observed": false,
      "rationale": "Flags seat/comfort discussion. Well grounded across samples (legroom, narrow padding, comfortable seat all -> 1; unrelated review -> 0). Some redundancy with the original 'Seat Comfort' numeric rating, but captures whether the topic was raised in free text."
    },
    {
      "name": "theme_food_quality",
      "analytical_usefulness": 0.8,
      "source_groundedness": 0.95,
      "hallucination_observed": false,
      "rationale": "Food-theme flag; clean extraction in all samples (delicious/plentiful/available -> 1, silent rows -> 0). Useful grouping axis for the query despite overlap with 'Food & Beverages' rating."
    },
    {
      "name": "theme_entertainment",
      "analytical_usefulness": 0.78,
      "source_groundedness": 0.82,
      "hallucination_observed": false,
      "rationale": "IFE-theme flag; mostly grounded (IFE variety, dreadful sound, movies -> 1). Sample 4 (truncated text with no clear entertainment mention) was set to 1, a mild over-assertion, but overall sound."
    },
    {
      "name": "theme_punctuality",
      "analytical_usefulness": 0.85,
      "source_groundedness": 0.6,
      "hallucination_observed": true,
      "rationale": "Adds a genuine new axis (no equivalent original column). However sample 1 fires punctuality=1 with no timeliness/delay language in the text, an unsupported assertion, lowering groundedness."
    },
    {
      "name": "theme_value_money",
      "analytical_usefulness": 0.75,
      "source_groundedness": 0.9,
      "hallucination_observed": false,
      "rationale": "Value-for-money theme flag; samples all 0 and consistent with texts that do not discuss price/value. Overlaps with existing 'Value For Money' rating but reflects a text-mention signal."
    },
    {
      "name": "theme_cleanliness",
      "analytical_usefulness": 0.85,
      "source_groundedness": 0.9,
      "hallucination_observed": false,
      "rationale": "New axis with no original counterpart. Well grounded (sanitized seat/clean bathroom -> 1; well-maintained cabin -> reasonable; silent rows -> 0)."
    },
    {
      "name": "theme_boarding",
      "analytical_usefulness": 0.75,
      "source_groundedness": 0.5,
      "hallucination_observed": true,
      "rationale": "Boarding is a useful new theme, but the flag fires spuriously: samples 1 and 3 are set to 1 despite no boarding/gate/embarkation language in the source text. This confident over-assertion materially undermines groundedness."
    },
    {
      "name": "review_sentiment_score",
      "analytical_usefulness": 0.65,
      "source_groundedness": 0.85,
      "hallucination_observed": false,
      "rationale": "Continuous sentiment is somewhat more useful than a bare positive/negative flag and can help relate tone to rating, though it partly restates Overall Rating/Recommended. Sample values (positive reviews ~0.75-1.0, all-negative review -1.0) are sound readings of the text."
    },
    {
      "name": "review_word_count",
      "analytical_usefulness": 0.12,
      "source_groundedness": 0.95,
      "hallucination_observed": false,
      "rationale": "Raw word count is explicitly a generic length feature that gives no analytical leverage for associating themes with rating across segments. It is mechanically derivable from the text (well grounded) but adds little value here."
    },
    {
      "name": "traveller_class_segment",
      "analytical_usefulness": 0.9,
      "source_groundedness": 0.98,
      "hallucination_observed": false,
      "rationale": "Concatenation of Type of Traveller and Class -- exactly the grouping key the query calls for ('Across Type of Traveller and Class'). Values match the two source columns; deterministic and correct."
    },
    {
      "name": "segment_mean_rating",
      "analytical_usefulness": 0.68,
      "source_groundedness": 0.95,
      "hallucination_observed": false,
      "rationale": "Per-segment mean of Overall Rating; provides a baseline for comparing segments and is derivable from the table. Somewhat restates the segment key, but supports higher-vs-lower rating comparison."
    },
    {
      "name": "rating_vs_segment_mean",
      "analytical_usefulness": 0.85,
      "source_groundedness": 0.95,
      "hallucination_observed": false,
      "rationale": "Row-level deviation of Overall Rating from its segment mean -- a normalized signal directly useful for seeing which themes accompany above/below-average ratings within a segment. Reconstructed Overall Ratings from the samples are internally consistent (e.g. mean 7.29 + 1.71 = 9, matching the '9/10' review)."
    }
  ],
  "analytical_usefulness": 0.76,
  "source_groundedness": 0.85,
  "rationale": "The added set is well aligned with the query: theme flags supply the 'review themes' axis, traveller_class_segment supplies the exact grouping key, and segment_mean_rating / rating_vs_segment_mean give normalized rating comparisons -- a strong analytical toolkit. Usefulness is dragged down modestly by review_word_count (generic length feature) and partial redundancy of several theme flags with existing numeric sub-ratings and of the sentiment score with Overall Rating. Groundedness is generally strong: theme extractions, sentiment, the segment key, and the rating-deviation arithmetic all check out against the sample texts. It is reduced by two themes that fire without textual support -- theme_boarding (spurious 1s in samples 1 and 3) and theme_punctuality (spurious 1 in sample 1) -- indicating some over-assertion in the noisier theme detectors."
}
